moves.name: Absorb
moves.text: An attack that absorbs half the damage inflicted.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Acid
moves.text: Sprays a hide-melting acid. May lower DEFENSE.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Acid Armor
moves.text: Liquifies the user’s body to sharply raise DEFENSE.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.text: An extremely speedy and unavoidable attack.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Aeroblast
moves.text: Launches a vacuumed blast. High critical-hit ratio.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Agility
moves.text: Relaxes the body to sharply boost SPEED.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.

moves.name: Air Cutter
moves.text: Hacks with razorlike wind. High critical-hit ratio.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Amnesia
moves.text: Forgets about something and sharply raises SP. DEF.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Special Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.text: An attack that may raise all stats.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats one stage.

moves.name: Arm Thrust
moves.text: Straight-arm punches that strike the foe 2 to 5 times.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Aromatherapy
moves.text: Heals all status problems with a soothing scent.
moves.desc: Removes major status effects and confusion from every Pokémon in the user’s party.

moves.name: Assist
moves.text: Attacks randomly with one of the partner’s moves.
moves.desc:
Uses a move from another Pokémon in the user’s party, both selected at random. Moves from fainted Pokémon can be used. If there are no eligible Pokémon or moves, this move will fail.

This move will not select Assist, Chatter, Circle Throw, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dig, Dive, Dragon Tail, Endure, Feint, Fly Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Phantom Force Protect, Quick Guard, Roar Shadow Force, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Struggle, Switcheroo, Thief, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wide Guard.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Metronome or Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Astonish
moves.text: An attack that may shock the foe into flinching.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Attract
moves.text: Makes the opposite gender less likely to attack.
moves.desc: Causes the target to fall in love with the user, giving it a 50% chance to do nothing each turn. If the user and target are the same gender, or either is genderless, this move will fail. If either Pokémon leaves the field, this effect ends.

moves.name: Aurora Beam
moves.text: Fires a rainbow-colored beam that may lower ATTACK.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Barrage
moves.text: Hurls round objects at the foe 2 to 5 times.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Barrier
moves.text: Creates a barrier that sharply raises DEFENSE.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Baton Pass
moves.text: Switches out the user while keeping effects in play.
moves.desc:
User switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party. Stat changes, confusion, and persistent move effects are passed along to the replacement Pokémon.

The following move effects are passed:

* Aqua Ring * both the user’s and target’s effect of Block, Mean Look, and Spider Web * the curse effect of Curse * Embargo * Focus Energy or an activated Lansat Berry * Gastro Acid * Ingrain * being sapped by Leech Seed * being targeted by Lock-On or Mind Reader * Magnet Rise * Perish Song’s counter * Power Trick * Substitute; the doll’s HP is unchanged

The replacement Pokémon does not trigger effects that respond to Pokémon switching in.

moves.name: Beat Up
moves.text: Summons party POKéMON to join in the attack.
moves.desc:
In Emerald:
• Determines damage using each participant’s base Attack and the opponent’s base Defense in place of calculated stats.

Inflicts typeless regular damage. Every Pokémon in the user’s party, excepting those that have fainted or have a major status effect, attacks the target. Calculated stats are ignored; the base stats for the target and assorted attackers are used instead. The random factor in the damage formula is not used. Dark Pokémon still get STAB.

This effect breaks through Wonder Guard.

moves.name: Belly Drum
moves.text: Maximizes ATTACK while sacrificing HP.
moves.desc: User pays half its max HP to raise its Attack to +6 stages. If the user cannot pay the HP cost, this move will fail.

moves.name: Bide
moves.text: Endures attack for 2 turns to retaliate double.
moves.desc:
In Emerald:
• Lasts either two or three turns.

User waits for two turns. On the second turn, the user inflicts twice the damage it accumulated on the last Pokémon to hit it. Damage inflicted is typeless.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Bind
moves.text: Binds and squeezes the foe for 2 to 5 turns.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

moves.name: Bite
moves.text: Bites with vicious fangs. May cause flinching.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Blast Burn
moves.text: Powerful, but leaves the user immobile the next turn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Blaze Kick
moves.text: A kick with a high critical- hit ratio. May cause a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.text: Hits the foe with an icy storm that may freeze it.
moves.desc:
In Emerald:
• Does not interact with Hail.

Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.

During Hail, this move has 100% accuracy. It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of Protect and Detect.

moves.name: Block
moves.text: Blocks the foe’s way to prevent escape.
moves.desc:
The target cannot switch out normally. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect ends when the user leaves the field.

The target may still escape by using Baton Pass, U-turn, or a Shed Shell.

Both the user and the target pass on this effect with Baton Pass.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.text: A full-body slam that may cause paralysis.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Bone Club
moves.text: Clubs the foe with a bone. May cause flinching.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Bone Rush
moves.text: Strikes the foe with a bone in hand 2 to 5 times.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Bonemerang
moves.text: Throws a bone boomerang that strikes twice.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

moves.name: Bounce
moves.text: Bounces up, then down the next turn. May paralyze.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User bounces high into the air for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

During the immune turn, Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thunder, and Twister still hit the user normally. Gust and Twister also have double power against the user.

The damage from Hail and Sandstorm still applies during the immune turn.

The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard.

This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.text: Destroys barriers such as REFLECT and causes damage.
moves.desc:
In Emerald:
• The barriers are destroyed even if this move has no effect.

Destroys any Light Screen or Reflect on the target’s side of the field, then inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Bubble
moves.text: An attack using bubbles. May lower the foe’s SPEED.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Bubble Beam
moves.text: Forcefully sprays bubbles that may lower SPEED.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.text: Bulks up the body to boost both ATTACK and DEFENSE.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage each.

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.text: Shoots 2 to 5 seeds in a row to strike the foe.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.text: Raises SP. ATK and SP. DEF by focusing the mind.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Special Attack and Special Defense by one stage each.

moves.name: Camouflage
moves.text: Alters the POKéMON’s type depending on the location.
moves.desc:
User’s type changes according to the terrain.

Terrain | New type -------------- | -------------- Building | Normal Cave | Rock Desert | Ground Grass | Grass Mountain | Rock Ocean | Water Pond | Water Road | Ground Snow | Ice Tall grass | Grass

In Pokémon Battle Revolution:

Terrain | New type -------------- | -------------- Courtyard | Normal Crystal | Rock Gateway | Water Magma | Rock Main Street | Normal Neon | Normal Stargazer | Rock Sunny Park | Grass Sunset | Ground Waterfall | Grass

moves.name: Charge
moves.text: Charges power to boost the electric move used next.
moves.desc:
In Emerald:
• Does not raise the user’s Special Defense.

Raises the user’s Special Defense by one stage. If the user uses an Electric move next turn, its power will be doubled.

moves.name: Charm
moves.text: Charms the foe and sharply reduces its ATTACK.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Clamp
moves.text: Traps and squeezes the foe for 2 to 5 turns.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

moves.name: Comet Punch
moves.text: Repeatedly punches the foe 2 to 5 times.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Confuse Ray
moves.text: A sinister ray that confuses the foe.
moves.desc: Confuses the target.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.text: A psychic attack that may cause confusion.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Constrict
moves.text: Constricts to inflict pain. May lower SPEED.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Conversion
moves.text: Changes the user’s type into a known move’s type.
moves.desc: User’s type changes to the type of one of its moves, selected at random. Hidden Power and Weather Ball are treated as Normal. Only moves with a different type are eligible, and Curse is never eligible. If the user has no suitable moves, this move will fail.

moves.name: Conversion 2
moves.text: Makes the user resistant to the last attack’s type.
moves.desc: Changes the user’s type to a type either resistant or immune to the last damaging move that hit it. The new type is selected at random and cannot be a type the user already is. If there is no eligible new type, this move will fail.

moves.name: Cosmic Power
moves.text: Raises DEFENSE and SP. DEF with a mystic power.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Cotton Spore
moves.text: Spores cling to the foe, sharply reducing SPEED.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.

moves.name: Counter
moves.text: Retaliates any physical hit with double the power.
moves.desc:
Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a physical move this turn. Inflicts twice the damage that move did to the user. If there is no eligible target, this move will fail. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Covet
moves.text: Cutely begs to obtain an item held by the foe.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding an item and the user is not, the user will permanently take the item. Damage is still inflicted if an item cannot be taken.

Pokémon with Sticky Hold or Multitype are immune to the item theft effect.

The target cannot recover its item with Recycle.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Crabhammer
moves.text: Hammers with a pincer. Has a high critical-hit ratio.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Cross Chop
moves.text: A double-chopping attack. High critical-hit ratio.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.text: Crunches with sharp fangs. May lower SP. DEF.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Crush Claw
moves.text: Tears at the foe with sharp claws. May lower DEFENSE.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Curse
moves.text: A move that functions differently for GHOSTS.
moves.desc:
If the user is a Ghost: user pays half its max HP to place a curse on the target, damaging it for 1/4 its max HP every turn. Otherwise: Lowers the user’s Speed by one stage, and raises its Attack and Defense by one stage each.

The curse effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Cut
moves.text: Cuts the foe with sharp scythes, claws, etc.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Defense Curl
moves.text: Curls up to conceal weak spots and raise DEFENSE.
moves.desc:
Raises user’s Defense by one stage.

After this move is used, the power of Ice Ball and Rollout are doubled until the user leaves the field.

moves.name: Destiny Bond
moves.text: If the user faints, the foe is also made to faint.
moves.desc:
If the user faints before its next move, the Pokémon that fainted it will automatically faint. End-of-turn damage is ignored.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Detect
moves.text: Evades attack, but may fail if used in succession.
moves.desc:
No moves will hit the user for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail.

If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail.

Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard provide a (100 – accuracy)% chance for moves to break through this move. This does not apply to one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold); those are always blocked by this move.

Thunder during Rain Dance and Blizzard during Hail have a 30% chance to break through this move.

The following effects are not prevented by this move:

* Acupressure from an ally * Curse’s curse effect * Delayed damage from Doom Desire and Future Sight; however, these moves will be prevented if they are used this turn * Feint, which will also end this move’s protection after it hits * Imprison * Perish Song * Shadow Force * Moves that merely copy the user, such as Transform or Psych Up

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Dig
moves.text: Digs underground the first turn and strikes next turn.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User digs underground for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.

During the immune turn, Earthquake, Fissure, and Magnitude still hit the user normally, and their power is doubled if appropriate.

The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Disable
moves.text: Psychically disables one of the foe’s moves.
moves.desc: Disables the target’s last used move, preventing its use for 4–7 turns, selected at random, or until the target leaves the field. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, if its last used move has 0 PP remaining, or if it already has a move disabled, this move will fail.

moves.name: Dive
moves.text: Dives underwater the first turn and strikes next turn.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User dives underwater for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.

During the immune turn, Surf, and Whirlpool still hit the user normally, and their power is doubled if appropriate.

The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Dizzy Punch
moves.text: A rhythmic punch that may confuse the foe.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Doom Desire
moves.text: Summons strong sunlight to attack 2 turns later.
moves.desc:
Inflicts typeless regular damage at the end of the third turn, starting with this one. This move cannot score a critical hit. If the target switches out, its replacement will be hit instead. Damage is calculated at the time this move is used; stat changes and switching out during the delay won’t change the damage inflicted. No move with this effect can be used against the same target again until after the end of the third turn.

This effect breaks through Wonder Guard.

If the target is protected by Protect or Detect on the turn this move is used, this move will fail. However, the damage on the third turn will break through protection.

The damage is applied at the end of the turn, so it ignores Endure and Focus Sash.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Double Kick
moves.text: A double-kicking attack that strikes the foe twice.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in one turn.

moves.name: Double Slap
moves.text: Repeatedly slaps the foe 2 to 5 times.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.text: Creates illusory copies to raise evasiveness.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s evasion by one stage.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.text: A life-risking tackle that also hurts the user.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Dragon Breath
moves.text: Strikes the foe with an incredible blast of breath.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Dragon Claw
moves.text: Slashes the foe with sharp claws.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Dragon Dance
moves.text: A mystical dance that ups ATTACK and SPEED.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Attack and Speed by one stage each.

moves.name: Dragon Rage
moves.text: Launches shock waves that always inflict 40 HP damage.
moves.desc: Inflicts exactly 40 damage.

moves.name: Dream Eater
moves.text: Takes one half the damage inflicted on a sleeping foe.
moves.desc: Fails if not used on a sleeping Pokémon. Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Drill Peck
moves.text: A corkscrewing attack with the beak acting as a drill.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Dynamic Punch
moves.text: Powerful and sure to cause confusion, but inaccurate.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.text: A powerful quake, but has no effect on flying foes.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage.

If the target is in the first turn of Dig, this move will hit with double power.

moves.name: Egg Bomb
moves.text: An egg is forcibly hurled at the foe.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Ember
moves.text: A weak fire attack that may inflict a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Encore
moves.text: Makes the foe repeat its last move over 2 to 6 turns.
moves.desc:
The next 4–8 times (selected at random) the target attempts to move, it is forced to repeat its last used move. If the selected move allows the trainer to select a target, an opponent will be selected at random each turn. If the target is prevented from using the selected move by some other effect, Struggle will be used instead. This effect ends if the selected move runs out of PP.

If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, if it does not know the selected move, or if the selected move has 0 PP remaining, this move will fail. If the target’s last used move was Encore, Mimic, Mirror Move, Sketch, Struggle, or Transform, this move will fail.

moves.name: Endeavor
moves.text: Gains power if the user’s HP is lower than the foe’s HP.
moves.desc: Inflicts exactly enough damage to lower the target’s HP to equal the user’s. If the target’s HP is not higher than the user’s, this move has no effect. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored. This effect counts as damage for moves that respond to damage.

moves.name: Endure
moves.text: Endures any attack for 1 turn, leaving at least 1HP.
moves.desc:
The user’s HP cannot be lowered below 1 by any means for the remainder of this turn.

If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Eruption
moves.text: The higher the user’s HP, the more damage caused.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the user’s remaining HP and is given by `150 * HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 150 when the user has full HP.

moves.name: Explosion
moves.text: Inflicts severe damage but makes the user faint.
moves.desc:
In Emerald:
• Halves the target’s Defense for damage calculation, which is similar to doubling the attack’s power.

User faints, even if the attack fails or misses. Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Extrasensory
moves.text: Attacks with a peculiar power. May cause flinching.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Extreme Speed
moves.text: An extremely fast and powerful attack.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Facade
moves.text: Boosts ATTACK when burned, paralyzed, or poisoned.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, this move has double power.

moves.name: Fake Out
moves.text: A 1st-turn, 1st-strike move that causes flinching.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Causes the target to flinch. Can only be used on the user’s first turn after entering the field.

moves.name: Fake Tears
moves.text: Feigns crying to sharply lower the foe’s SP. DEF.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

moves.name: False Swipe
moves.text: An attack that leaves the foe with at least 1 HP.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Will not reduce the target’s HP below 1.

moves.name: Feather Dance
moves.text: Envelops the foe with down to sharply reduce ATTACK.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Feint Attack
moves.text: Draws the foe close, then strikes without fail.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Fire Blast
moves.text: Incinerates everything it strikes. May cause a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Fire Punch
moves.text: A fiery punch that may burn the foe.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Fire Spin
moves.text: Traps the foe in a ring of fire for 2 to 5 turns.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

moves.name: Fissure
moves.text: A one-hit KO move that drops the foe in a fissure.
moves.desc:
Inflicts damage equal to the target’s max HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move’s accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target. If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail.

Because this move inflicts a specific and finite amount of damage, Endure still prevents the target from fainting.

The effects of Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. However, they will not give this move a chance to break through Detect or Protect.

moves.name: Flail
moves.text: Inflicts more damage when the user’s HP is down.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Power varies inversely with the user’s proportional remaining HP.

64 * current HP / max HP | Power -----------------------: | ----: 0– 1 | 200 2– 5 | 150 6–12 | 100 13–21 | 80 22–42 | 40 43–64 | 20

moves.name: Flame Wheel
moves.text: A fiery charge attack that may inflict a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target. Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.text: A powerful fire attack that may inflict a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Flash
moves.text: Looses a powerful blast of light that cuts accuracy.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Flatter
moves.text: Confuses the foe, but raises its SP. ATK.
moves.desc: Raises the target’s Special Attack by one stage, then confuses it.

moves.name: Fly
moves.text: Flies up on the first turn, then strikes the next turn.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User flies high into the air for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.

During the immune turn, Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thunder, Twister, and Whirlwind still hit the user normally. Gust and Twister also have double power against the user.

The damage from Hail and Sandstorm still applies during the immune turn.

The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of Lock-On, Mind Reader, or No Guard.

This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Focus Energy
moves.text: Focuses power to raise the critical-hit ratio.
moves.desc:
User’s critical hit rate is two levels higher until it leaves the field. If the user has already used Focus Energy since entering the field, this move will fail.

This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

moves.name: Focus Punch
moves.text: A powerful loyalty attack. The user flinches if hit.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. If the user takes damage this turn before hitting, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Follow Me
moves.text: Draws attention to make foes attack only the user.
moves.desc:
Until the end of this turn, any moves that opposing Pokémon target solely at the user’s ally will instead target the user. If both Pokémon on the same side of the field use this move on the same turn, the Pokémon that uses it last will become the target.

This effect takes priority over Lightning Rod and Storm Drain.

If the user’s ally switches out, opposing Pokémon may still hit it with Pursuit.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Foresight
moves.text: Negates the foe’s efforts to heighten evasiveness.
moves.desc: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Ghost under this effect takes normal damage from Normal and Fighting moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Frenzy Plant
moves.text: Powerful, but leaves the user immobile the next turn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Frustration
moves.text: An attack that is stronger if the TRAINER is disliked.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases inversely with happiness, given by `(255 - happiness) * 2 / 5`, to a maximum of 102. Power bottoms out at 1.

moves.name: Fury Attack
moves.text: Jabs the foe 2 to 5 times with sharp horns, etc.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Fury Cutter
moves.text: An attack that intensifies on each successive hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Power doubles after every time this move is used, whether consecutively or not, maxing out at 16x. If this move misses or the user leaves the field, power resets.

moves.name: Fury Swipes
moves.text: Rakes the foe with sharp claws, etc., 2 to 5 times.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Future Sight
moves.text: Heightens inner power to strike 2 turns later.
moves.desc:
Inflicts typeless regular damage at the end of the third turn, starting with this one. This move cannot score a critical hit. If the target switches out, its replacement will be hit instead. Damage is calculated at the time this move is used; stat changes and switching out during the delay won’t change the damage inflicted. No move with this effect can be used against the same target again until after the end of the third turn.

This effect breaks through Wonder Guard.

If the target is protected by Protect or Detect on the turn this move is used, this move will fail. However, the damage on the third turn will break through protection.

The damage is applied at the end of the turn, so it ignores Endure and Focus Sash.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.text: An attack that steals half the damage inflicted.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Glare
moves.text: Intimidates and frightens the foe into paralysis.
moves.desc: Paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Grass Whistle
moves.text: Lulls the foe into sleep with a pleasant melody.
moves.desc: Puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Growl
moves.text: Growls cutely to reduce the foe’s ATTACK.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Growth
moves.text: Forces the body to grow and heightens SP. ATK.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Grudge
moves.text: If the user faints, deletes all PP of foe’s last move.
moves.desc: If the user faints before it next acts, the move that fainted it will have its PP dropped to 0. End-of-turn damage does not trigger this effect.

moves.name: Guillotine
moves.text: A powerful pincer attack that may cause fainting.
moves.desc:
Inflicts damage equal to the target’s max HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move’s accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target. If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail.

Because this move inflicts a specific and finite amount of damage, Endure still prevents the target from fainting.

The effects of Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. However, they will not give this move a chance to break through Detect or Protect.

moves.name: Gust
moves.text: Strikes the foe with a gust of wind whipped up by wings.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage.

If the target is under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, this move will hit with double power.

moves.name: Hail
moves.text: Summons a hailstorm that strikes every turn.
moves.desc:
Changes the weather to hail for five turns, during which non-Ice Pokémon are damaged for 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn.

If the user is holding Icy Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns.

Blizzard has 100% accuracy. If the target has used Detect or Protect, Blizzard has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection.

Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP.

Pokémon with Snow Cloak are exempt from this effect’s damage.

moves.name: Harden
moves.text: Stiffens the body’s muscles to raise DEFENSE.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Haze
moves.text: Creates a black haze that eliminates all stat changes.
moves.desc:
Removes stat, accuracy, and evasion modifiers from every Pokémon on the field.

This does not count as a stat reduction for the purposes of Clear Body or White Smoke.

moves.name: Headbutt
moves.text: A ramming attack that may cause flinching.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Heal Bell
moves.text: Chimes soothingly to heal all status abnormalities.
moves.desc: Removes major status effects and confusion from every Pokémon in the user’s party.

moves.name: Heat Wave
moves.text: Exhales a hot breath on the foe. May inflict a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.text: Boosts the power of the recipient’s moves.
moves.desc:
Boosts the power of the target’s moves by 50% until the end of this turn.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Hidden Power
moves.text: The effectiveness varies with the user.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Power and type are determined by the user’s IVs.

Power is given by `x * 40 / 63 + 30`. `x` is obtained by arranging bit 1 from the IV for each of Special Defense, Special Attack, Speed, Defense, Attack, and HP in that order. (Bit 1 is 1 if the IV is of the form `4n + 2` or `4n + 3`. `x` is then 64 * Special Defense IV bit 1, plus 32 * Special Attack IV bit 1, etc.)

Power is always between 30 and 70, inclusive. Average power is 49.5.

Type is given by `y * 15 / 63`, where `y` is similar to `x` above, except constructed from bit 0. (Bit 0 is 1 if the IV is odd.) The result is looked up in the following table.

Value | Type ----: | -------- 0 | Fighting 1 | Flying 2 | Poison 3 | Ground 4 | Rock 5 | Bug 6 | Ghost 7 | Steel 8 | Fire 9 | Water 10 | Grass 11 | Electric 12 | Psychic 13 | Ice 14 | Dragon 15 | Dark

This move thus cannot be Normal. Most other types have an equal 1/16 chance to be selected, given random IVs. However, due to the flooring used here, Bug, Fighting, and Grass appear 5/64 of the time, and Dark only 1/64 of the time.

moves.name: High Jump Kick
moves.text: A jumping knee kick. If it misses, the user is hurt.
moves.desc:
In Emerald:
• If this move misses, the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP rounded down.

Inflicts regular damage. If this move misses, is blocked by Protect or Detect, or has no effect, the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP rounded down.

This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect.

moves.name: Horn Attack
moves.text: Jabs the foe with sharp horns.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Horn Drill
moves.text: A one-hit KO attack that uses a horn like a drill.
moves.desc:
Inflicts damage equal to the target’s max HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move’s accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target. If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail.

Because this move inflicts a specific and finite amount of damage, Endure still prevents the target from fainting.

The effects of Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. However, they will not give this move a chance to break through Detect or Protect.

moves.name: Howl
moves.text: Howls to raise the spirit and boosts ATTACK.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Hydro Cannon
moves.text: Powerful, but leaves the user immobile the next turn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.text: Blasts water at high power to strike the foe.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.text: Powerful, but leaves the user immobile the next turn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User loses its next turn to "recharge", and cannot attack or switch out during that turn.

moves.name: Hyper Fang
moves.text: Attacks with sharp fangs. May cause flinching.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Hyper Voice
moves.text: A loud attack that uses sound waves to injure.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.text: A hypnotizing move that may induce sleep.
moves.desc: Puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Ice Ball
moves.text: A 5-turn attack that gains power on successive hits.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to use this move for five turns. Power doubles every time this move is used in succession to a maximum of 16x, and resets to normal after the lock-in ends. If this move misses or becomes unusable, the lock-in ends.

If the user has used Defense Curl since entering the field, this move has double power.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.text: Blasts the foe with an icy beam that may freeze it.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.

moves.name: Ice Punch
moves.text: An icy punch that may freeze the foe.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.

moves.name: Icicle Spear
moves.text: Attacks the foe by firing 2 to 5 icicles in a row.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.text: A chilling attack that lowers the foe’s SPEED.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Imprison
moves.text: Prevents foes from using moves known by the user.
moves.desc: Prevents any Pokémon on the opposing side of the field from using any move the user knows until the user leaves the field. This effect is live; if the user obtains new moves while on the field, these moves become restricted. If no opposing Pokémon knows any of the user’s moves when this move is used, this move will fail.

moves.name: Ingrain
moves.text: Lays roots that restore HP. The user can’t switch out.
moves.desc:
Prevents the user from switching out. User regains 1/16 of its max HP at the end of every turn. If the user was immune to Ground attacks, it will now take normal damage from them.

Roar and Whirlwind will not affect the user. The user cannot use Magnet Rise.

The user may still use U-turn to leave the field.

This effect can be passed with Baton Pass.

moves.name: Iron Defense
moves.text: Hardens the body’s surface to sharply raise DEFENSE.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Iron Tail
moves.text: Attacks with a rock-hard tail. May lower DEFENSE.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Jump Kick
moves.text: A strong jumping kick. May miss and hurt the kicker.
moves.desc:
In Emerald:
• If this move misses, the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP rounded down.

Inflicts regular damage. If this move misses, is blocked by Protect or Detect, or has no effect, the user takes damage equal to half of its max HP rounded down.

This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect.

moves.name: Karate Chop
moves.text: A chopping attack with a high critical-hit ratio.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Kinesis
moves.text: Distracts the foe. May lower accuracy.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Knock Off
moves.text: Knocks down the foe’s held item to prevent its use.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Target loses its held item.

Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle.

If the target has Multitype or Sticky Hold, it will take damage but not lose its item.

moves.name: Leaf Blade
moves.text: Slashes with a sharp leaf. High critical-hit ratio.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Leech Life
moves.text: An attack that steals half the damage inflicted.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Leech Seed
moves.text: Plants a seed on the foe to steal HP on every turn.
moves.desc:
Plants a seed on the target that drains 1/8 of its max HP at the end of every turn and heals the user for the amount taken. Has no effect on Grass Pokémon. The seed remains until the target leaves the field.

The user takes damage instead of being healed if the target has Liquid Ooze.

Rapid Spin will remove this effect.

This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

moves.name: Leer
moves.text: Frightens the foe with a leer to lower DEFENSE.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Lick
moves.text: Licks with a long tongue to injure. May also paralyze.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.text: Creates a wall of light that lowers SP. ATK damage.
moves.desc:
Erects a barrier around the user’s side of the field that reduces damage from special attacks by half for five turns. In double battles, the reduction is 1/3. Critical hits are not affected by the barrier.

If the user is holding Light Clay, the barrier lasts for eight turns.

Brick Break or Defog used by an opponent will destroy the barrier.

moves.name: Lock-On
moves.text: Locks on to the foe to ensure the next move hits.
moves.desc:
If the user targets the same target again before the end of the next turn, the move it uses is guaranteed to hit. This move itself also ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

One-hit KO moves are also guaranteed to hit, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. This effect also allows the user to hit Pokémon that are off the field due to moves such as Dig or Fly.

If the target uses Detect or Protect while under the effect of this move, the user is not guaranteed to hit, but has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection.

This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

moves.name: Lovely Kiss
moves.text: Demands a kiss with a scary face that induces sleep.
moves.desc: Puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Low Kick
moves.text: A kick that inflicts more damage on heavier foes.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the target’s weight in kilograms, to a maximum of 120.

Target’s weight | Power --------------- | ----: Up to 10kg | 20 Up to 25kg | 40 Up to 50kg | 60 Up to 100kg | 80 Up to 200kg | 100 Above 200kg | 120

moves.name: Luster Purge
moves.text: Attacks with a burst of light. May lower SP. DEF.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Mach Punch
moves.text: A punch is thrown at wicked speed to strike first.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Magic Coat
moves.text: Reflects special effects back to the attacker.
moves.desc:
The first non-damaging move targeting the user this turn that inflicts major status effects, stat changes, or trapping effects will be reflected at its user.

Defog, Memento, and Teeter Dance are not reflected.

Attract, Flatter, Gastro Acid, Leech Seed, Swagger, Worry Seed, and Yawn are reflected.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Magical Leaf
moves.text: Attacks with a strange leaf that cannot be evaded.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Magnitude
moves.text: A ground-shaking attack of random intensity.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Power is selected at random between 10 and 150, with an average of 71:

Magnitude | Power | Chance --------: | ----: | -----: 4 | 10 | 5% 5 | 30 | 10% 6 | 50 | 20% 7 | 70 | 30% 8 | 90 | 20% 9 | 110 | 10% 10 | 150 | 5%

This move has double power against Pokémon currently underground due to Dig.

moves.name: Mean Look
moves.text: Fixes the foe with a mean look that prevents escape.
moves.desc:
The target cannot switch out normally. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect ends when the user leaves the field.

The target may still escape by using Baton Pass, U-turn, or a Shed Shell.

Both the user and the target pass on this effect with Baton Pass.

moves.name: Meditate
moves.text: Meditates in a peaceful fashion to raise ATTACK.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Mega Drain
moves.text: An attack that absorbs half the damage inflicted.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

moves.name: Mega Kick
moves.text: An extremely powerful kick with intense force.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Mega Punch
moves.text: A strong punch thrown with incredible power.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Megahorn
moves.text: A brutal ramming attack using out-thrust horns.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Memento
moves.text: The user faints and lowers the foe’s abilities.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack and Special Attack by two stages. User faints.

moves.name: Metal Claw
moves.text: A claw attack that may raise the user’s ATTACK.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack one stage.

moves.name: Metal Sound
moves.text: Emits a horrible screech that sharply lowers SP. DEF.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Special Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Meteor Mash
moves.text: Fires a meteor-like punch. May raise ATTACK.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Attack one stage.

moves.name: Metronome
moves.text: Waggles a finger to use any POKéMON move at random.
moves.desc:
Selects any move at random and uses it. Moves the user already knows are not eligible. Assist, meta, protection, and reflection moves are also not eligible; specifically, Assist, Chatter, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Endure, Feint, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Protect, Quick Guard, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Struggle, Switcheroo, Thief, Trick, and Wide Guard will not be selected by this move.

This move cannot be copied by Mimic or Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Milk Drink
moves.text: Recovers up to half the user’s maximum HP.
moves.desc: Heals the user for half its max HP.

moves.name: Mimic
moves.text: Copies a move used by the foe during one battle.
moves.desc:
This move is replaced by the target’s last successfully used move, and its PP changes to 5. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, or if the user already knows the targeted move, this move will fail. This effect vanishes when the user leaves the field.

If Chatter, Metronome, Mimic, Sketch, or Struggle is selected, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome, nor forced by Encore.

moves.name: Mind Reader
moves.text: Senses the foe’s action to ensure the next move’s hit.
moves.desc:
If the user targets the same target again before the end of the next turn, the move it uses is guaranteed to hit. This move itself also ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

One-hit KO moves are also guaranteed to hit, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. This effect also allows the user to hit Pokémon that are off the field due to moves such as Dig or Fly.

If the target uses Detect or Protect while under the effect of this move, the user is not guaranteed to hit, but has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection.

This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

moves.name: Minimize
moves.text: Minimizes the user’s size to raise evasiveness.
moves.desc:
In Emerald:
• Raises evasion by one stage.

Raises the user’s evasion by two stages.

Stomp and Steamroller have double power against Pokémon that have used this move since entering the field.

moves.name: Mirror Coat
moves.text: Counters the foe’s special attack at double the power.
moves.desc:
Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a special move this turn. Inflicts twice the damage that move did to the user. If there is no eligible target, this move will fail. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Mirror Move
moves.text: Counters the foe’s attack with the same move.
moves.desc:
Uses the last move targeted at the user by a Pokémon still on the field. A move counts as targeting the user even if it hit multiple Pokémon, as long as the user was one of them; however, moves targeting the field itself do not count. If the user has not been targeted by an appropriate move since entering the field, or if no Pokémon that targeted the user remains on the field, this move will fail.

Moves that failed, missed, had no effect, or were blocked are still copied.

Assist moves, time-delayed moves, “meta” moves that operate on other moves/Pokémon/abilities, and some other special moves cannot be copied and are ignored; if the last move to hit the user was such a move, the previous move will be used instead. The full list of ignored moves is: Acid Armor, Acupressure, After You, Agility, Ally Switch, Amnesia, Aqua Ring, Aromatherapy, Aromatic Mist, Assist, Autotomize, Barrier, Baton Pass, Belch, Belly Drum, Bide, Bulk Up, Calm Mind, Camouflage, Celebrate, Charge, Coil, Conversion, Conversion 2, Copycat, Cosmic Power, Cotton Guard, Counter, Crafty Shield, Curse, Defend Order, Defense Curl, Destiny Bond, Detect, Doom Desire, Double Team, Dragon Dance, Electric Terrain, Endure, Final Gambit, Flower Shield, Focus Energy, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Future Sight, Geomancy, Grassy Terrain, Gravity, Growth, Grudge, Guard Split, Hail, Happy Hour, Harden, Haze, Heal Bell, Heal Order, Heal Pulse, Healing Wish, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, Hone Claws, Howl, Imprison, Ingrain, Ion Deluge, Iron Defense, King’s Shield, Light Screen, Lucky Chant, Lunar Dance, Magic Coat, Magnet Rise, Magnetic Flux, Mat Block, Me First, Meditate, Metronome, Milk Drink, Mimic, Minimize, Mirror Coat, Mirror Move, Mist, Misty Terrain, Moonlight, Morning Sun, Mud Sport, Nasty Plot, Nature Power, Perish Song, Power Split, Power Trick, Protect, Psych Up, Quick Guard, Quiver Dance, Rage Powder, Rain Dance, Recover, Recycle, Reflect, Reflect Type, Refresh, Rest, Rock Polish, Role Play, Roost, Rototiller, Safeguard, Sandstorm, Shadow Blast, Shadow Bolt, Shadow Half, Shadow Rush, Shadow Shed, Shadow Sky, Shadow Storm, Shadow Wave, Sharpen, Shell Smash, Shift Gear, Sketch, Slack Off, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Soft-Boiled, Spikes, Spiky Shield, Spit Up, Splash, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Stockpile, Struggle, Substitute, Sunny Day, Swallow, Swords Dance, Synthesis, Tail Glow, Tailwind, Teleport, Toxic Spikes, Transform, Water Sport, Wide Guard, Wish, Withdraw and Work Up.

This move cannot be selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk, nor forced by Encore.

moves.name: Mist
moves.text: Creates a mist that stops reduction of abilities.
moves.desc:
Pokémon on the user’s side of the field are immune to stat-lowering effects for five turns.

Guard Swap, Heart Swap, and Power Swap may still be used.

Defog used by an opponent will end this effect.

moves.name: Mist Ball
moves.text: Attacks with a flurry of down. May lower SP. ATK.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Moonlight
moves.text: Restores HP. The amount varies with the weather.
moves.desc:
Heals the user for half its max HP.

During Sunny Day, the healing is increased to 2/3 max HP.

During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, the healing is decreased to 1/4 max HP.

moves.name: Morning Sun
moves.text: Restores HP. The amount varies with the weather.
moves.desc:
Heals the user for half its max HP.

During Sunny Day, the healing is increased to 2/3 max HP.

During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, the healing is decreased to 1/4 max HP.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.text: Hurls mud at the foe and reduces SPEED.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Mud Sport
moves.text: Covers the user in mud to raise electrical resistance.
moves.desc: Electric moves inflict half damage, regardless of target. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.text: Hurls mud in the foe’s face to reduce its accuracy.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Muddy Water
moves.text: Attacks with muddy water. May lower accuracy.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Nature Power
moves.text: The type of attack varies depending on the location.
moves.desc:

moves.name: Needle Arm
moves.text: Attacks with thorny arms. May cause flinching.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Night Shade
moves.text: Inflicts damage identical to the user’s level.
moves.desc: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

moves.name: Nightmare
moves.text: Inflicts 1/4 damage on a sleeping foe every turn.
moves.desc: Only works on sleeping Pokémon. Gives the target a nightmare, damaging it for 1/4 its max HP every turn. If the target wakes up or leaves the field, this effect ends.

moves.name: Octazooka
moves.text: Fires a lump of ink to damage and cut accuracy.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Odor Sleuth
moves.text: Negates the foe’s efforts to heighten evasiveness.
moves.desc: Resets the target’s evasion to normal and prevents any further boosting until the target leaves the field. A Ghost under this effect takes normal damage from Normal and Fighting moves. This move itself ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Outrage
moves.text: A rampage of 2 to 3 turns that confuses the user.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to attack with this move for 2–3 turns,selected at random. After the last hit, the user becomes confused.

Safeguard does not protect against the confusion from this move.

moves.name: Overheat
moves.text: Allows a full-power attack, but sharply lowers SP. ATK.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Pain Split
moves.text: Adds the user and foe’s HP, then shares them equally.
moves.desc:
Changes the user’s and target’s remaining HP to the average of their current remaining HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect does not count as inflicting damage for other moves and effects that respond to damage taken.

This effect fails against a Substitute.

moves.name: Pay Day
moves.text: Throws coins at the foe. Money is recovered after.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. After the battle ends, the winner receives five times the user’s level in extra money for each time this move was used.

moves.name: Peck
moves.text: Attacks the foe with a jabbing beak, etc.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Perish Song
moves.text: Any POKéMON hearing this song faints in 3 turns.
moves.desc:
Every Pokémon is given a counter that starts at 3 and decreases by 1 at the end of every turn, including this one. When a Pokémon’s counter reaches zero, that Pokémon faints. A Pokémon that leaves the field will lose its counter; its replacement does not inherit the effect, and other Pokémon’s counters remain.

This effect is passed on by Baton Pass.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Petal Dance
moves.text: A rampage of 2 to 3 turns that confuses the user.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to attack with this move for 2–3 turns,selected at random. After the last hit, the user becomes confused.

Safeguard does not protect against the confusion from this move.

moves.name: Pin Missile
moves.text: Sharp pins are fired to strike 2 to 5 times.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Poison Fang
moves.text: A sharp-fanged attack. May badly poison the foe.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to badly poison the target.

moves.name: Poison Gas
moves.text: Envelops the foe in a toxic gas that may poison.
moves.desc: Poisons the target.

moves.name: Poison Powder
moves.text: Scatters a toxic powder that may poison the foe.
moves.desc: Poisons the target.

moves.name: Poison Sting
moves.text: A toxic attack with barbs, etc., that may poison.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Poison Tail
moves.text: Has a high critical-hit ratio. May also poison.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Pound
moves.text: Pounds the foe with forelegs or tail.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Powder Snow
moves.text: Blasts the foe with a snowy gust. May cause freezing.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to freeze the target.

moves.name: Present
moves.text: A gift in the form of a bomb. May restore HP.
moves.desc:
Randomly uses one of the following effects.

Effect | Chance -------------------------------------------------- | -----: Inflicts regular damage with 40 power | 40% Inflicts regular damage with 80 power | 30% Inflicts regular damage with 120 power | 10% Heals the target for 1/4 its max HP | 20%

On average, this move inflicts regular damage with 52 power and heals the target for 1/20 its max HP.

moves.name: Protect
moves.text: Evades attack, but may fail if used in succession.
moves.desc:
No moves will hit the user for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail.

If the user successfully used Detect, Endure, Protect, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail.

Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard provide a (100 – accuracy)% chance for moves to break through this move. This does not apply to one-hit KO moves (Fissure, Guillotine, Horn Drill, and Sheer Cold); those are always blocked by this move.

Thunder during Rain Dance and Blizzard during Hail have a 30% chance to break through this move.

The following effects are not prevented by this move:

* Acupressure from an ally * Curse’s curse effect * Delayed damage from Doom Desire and Future Sight; however, these moves will be prevented if they are used this turn * Feint, which will also end this move’s protection after it hits * Imprison * Perish Song * Shadow Force * Moves that merely copy the user, such as Transform or Psych Up

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Psybeam
moves.text: Fires a peculiar ray that may confuse the foe.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.text: Copies the foe’s effect(s) and gives to the user.
moves.desc:
Discards the user’s stat changes and copies the target’s.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.text: A powerful psychic attack that may lower SP. DEF.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Psycho Boost
moves.text: Allows a full-power attack, but sharply lowers SP. ATK.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Psywave
moves.text: Attacks with a psychic wave of varying intensity.
moves.desc: Inflicts typeless damage between 50% and 150% of the user’s level, selected at random in increments of 10%.

moves.name: Pursuit
moves.text: Inflicts bad damage if used on a foe switching out.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. If the target attempts to switch out this turn before the user acts, this move hits the target before it leaves and has double power.

This effect can still hit a Pokémon that switches out when it has a Substitute up or when an ally has used Follow Me.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.text: An extremely fast attack that always strikes first.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Rage
moves.text: Raises the user’s ATTACK every time it is hit.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Every time the user is hit after it uses this move but before its next action, its Attack raises by one stage.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.text: Boosts the power of WATER- type moves for 5 turns.
moves.desc:
Changes the weather to rain for five turns, during which Water moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Fire moves inflict half damage.

If the user is holding Damp Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns.

Thunder has 100% accuracy. If the target has used Detect or Protect, Thunder has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection.

Solar Beam has half power.

Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal only 1/4 of the user’s max HP.

Pokémon with Swift Swim have doubled original Speed.

Pokémon with Forecast become Water.

Pokémon with Dry Skin heal 1/8 max HP, Pokémon with Hydration are cured of major status effects, and Pokémon with Rain Dish heal 1/16 max HP at the end of each turn.

moves.name: Rapid Spin
moves.text: Spins the body at high speed to strike the foe.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Removes Leech Seed from the user, frees the user from Bind, Clamp, Fire Spin, Magma Storm, Sand Tomb, Whirlpool, and Wrap, and clears Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Toxic Spikes from the user’s side of the field. If this move misses or has no effect, its effect doesn’t activate.

moves.name: Razor Leaf
moves.text: Cuts the enemy with leaves. High critical-hit ratio.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Razor Wind
moves.text: A 2-turn move that strikes the foe on the 2nd turn.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move. User charges for one turn before attacking.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Recover
moves.text: Recovers up to half the user’s maximum HP.
moves.desc: Heals the user for half its max HP.

moves.name: Recycle
moves.text: Recycles a used item for one more use.
moves.desc:
User recovers the last item consumed by the user or a Pokémon in its position on the field. The item must be used again before it can be recovered by this move again. If the user is holding an item, this move fails.

Items taken or given away by Covet, Knock Off, Switcheroo, Thief, or Trick may not be recovered.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.text: Creates a wall of light that weakens physical attacks.
moves.desc:
Erects a barrier around the user’s side of the field that reduces damage from physical attacks by half for five turns. In double battles, the reduction is 1/3. Critical hits are not affected by the barrier.

If the user is holding Light Clay, the barrier lasts for eight turns.

Brick Break or Defog used by an opponent will destroy the barrier.

moves.name: Refresh
moves.text: Heals poisoning, paralysis, or a burn.
moves.desc: Removes a burn, paralysis, or poison from the user.

moves.name: Rest
moves.text: The user sleeps for 2 turns, restoring HP and status.
moves.desc:
In Emerald:
• Works while asleep through Sleep Talk if not at full health.

User falls to sleep and immediately regains all its HP. If the user has another major status effect, sleep will replace it. The user will always wake up after two turns, or one turn with Early Bird.

This move fails if the Pokémon cannot fall asleep due to Uproar, Insomnia, or Vital Spirit. It also fails if the Pokémon is at full health or is already asleep.

moves.name: Return
moves.text: An attack that increases in power with friendship.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with happiness, given by `happiness * 2 / 5`, to a maximum of 102. Power bottoms out at 1.

moves.name: Revenge
moves.text: An attack that gains power if injured by the foe.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. If the target damaged the user this turn and was the last to do so, this move has double power.

Pain Split does not count as damaging the user.

moves.name: Reversal
moves.text: Inflicts more damage when the user’s HP is down.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Power varies inversely with the user’s proportional remaining HP.

64 * current HP / max HP | Power -----------------------: | ----: 0– 1 | 200 2– 5 | 150 6–12 | 100 13–21 | 80 22–42 | 40 43–64 | 20

moves.name: Roar
moves.text: Makes the foe flee to end the battle.
moves.desc:
Switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon selected at random. Wild battles end immediately.

Doesn’t affect Pokémon with Suction Cups or under the effect of Ingrain.

moves.name: Rock Blast
moves.text: Hurls boulders at the foe 2 to 5 times in a row.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.text: Large boulders are hurled. May cause flinching.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Rock Smash
moves.text: A rock-crushing attack that may lower DEFENSE.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Rock Throw
moves.text: Throws small rocks to strike the foe.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.text: Stops the foe from moving with rocks and cuts SPEED.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Role Play
moves.text: Mimics the target and copies its special ability.
moves.desc:
User’s ability is replaced with the target’s until the user leaves the field. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

If the target has Flower Gift, Forecast, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Stance Change, Trace, Wonder Guard, or Zen Mode, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Rolling Kick
moves.text: A fast kick delivered from a rapid spin.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Rollout
moves.text: An attack lasting 5 turns with rising intensity.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to use this move for five turns. Power doubles every time this move is used in succession to a maximum of 16x, and resets to normal after the lock-in ends. If this move misses or becomes unusable, the lock-in ends.

If the user has used Defense Curl since entering the field, this move has double power.

moves.name: Sacred Fire
moves.text: A mystical fire attack that may inflict a burn.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn the target. Frozen Pokémon may use this move, in which case they will thaw.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.text: A mystical force prevents all status problems.
moves.desc:
Protects Pokémon on the user’s side of the field from major status effects and confusion for five turns. Does not cancel existing ailments. This effect remains even if the user leaves the field.

If Yawn is used while this move is in effect, it will immediately fail.

Defog used by an opponent will end this effect.

This effect does not prevent the confusion caused by Outrage, Petal Dance, or Thrash.

moves.name: Sand Attack
moves.text: Reduces the foe’s accuracy by hurling sand in its face.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Sand Tomb
moves.text: Traps and hurts the foe in quicksand for 2 to 5 turns.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

moves.name: Sandstorm
moves.text: Causes a sandstorm that rages for several turns.
moves.desc:
Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns. Pokémon that are not Ground, Rock, or Steel take 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn. Every Rock Pokémon’s original Special Defense is raised by 50% for the duration of this effect.

Solar Beam’s power is halved.

Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis only heal 1/4 the user’s max HP.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.text: Frightens with a scary face to sharply reduce SPEED.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Speed by two stages.

moves.name: Scratch
moves.text: Scratches the foe with sharp claws.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Screech
moves.text: Emits a screech to sharply reduce the foe’s DEFENSE.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Defense by two stages.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.text: An attack with effects that vary by location.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to inflict an effect chosen according to the terrain.

Terrain | Effect -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- Building | Paralyzes target Cave | Makes target flinch Deep water | Lowers target’s Attack by one stage Desert | Lowers target’s accuracy by one stage Grass | Puts target to sleep Mountain | Makes target flinch Road | Lowers target’s accuracy by one stage Shallow water | Lowers target’s Attack by one stage Snow | Freezes target Tall grass | Puts target to sleep
