moves.name: Seismic Toss
moves.text: Inflicts damage identical to the user’s level.
moves.desc: Inflicts damage equal to the user’s level. Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.

moves.name: Self-Destruct
moves.text: Inflicts severe damage but makes the user faint.
moves.desc:
In Emerald:
• Halves the target’s Defense for damage calculation, which is similar to doubling the attack’s power.

User faints, even if the attack fails or misses. Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.text: Hurls a black blob that may lower the foe’s SP. DEF.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Shadow Punch
moves.text: An unavoidable punch that is thrown from shadows.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Sharpen
moves.text: Reduces the polygon count and raises ATTACK.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Attack by one stage.

moves.name: Sheer Cold
moves.text: A chilling attack that causes fainting if it hits.
moves.desc:
Inflicts damage equal to the target’s max HP. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This move’s accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target. If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail.

Because this move inflicts a specific and finite amount of damage, Endure still prevents the target from fainting.

The effects of Lock-On, Mind Reader, and No Guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target. However, they will not give this move a chance to break through Detect or Protect.

moves.name: Shock Wave
moves.text: A fast and unavoidable electric attack.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Signal Beam
moves.text: A strange beam attack that may confuse the foe.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Silver Wind
moves.text: A powdery attack that may raise abilities.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise all of the user’s stats one stage.

moves.name: Sing
moves.text: A soothing song lulls the foe into a deep slumber.
moves.desc: Puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Sketch
moves.text: Copies the foe’s last move permanently.
moves.desc:
Permanently replaces itself with the target’s last used move. If that move is Chatter or Struggle, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by Mimic or Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome, nor forced by Encore.

moves.name: Skill Swap
moves.text: The user swaps special abilities with the target.
moves.desc:
User and target switch abilities. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

If either Pokémon has Multitype or Wonder Guard, this move will fail.

moves.name: Skull Bash
moves.text: Tucks in the head, then attacks on the next turn.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Raises the user’s Defense by one stage. User then charges for one turn before attacking.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Sky Attack
moves.text: Searches out weak spots, then strikes the next turn.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User charges for one turn before attacking. Critical hit chance is one level higher than normal. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Sky Uppercut
moves.text: An uppercut thrown as if leaping into the sky.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage.

This move can hit Pokémon under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop.

moves.name: Slack Off
moves.text: Slacks off and restores half the maximum HP.
moves.desc: Heals the user for half its max HP.

moves.name: Slam
moves.text: Slams the foe with a long tail, vine, etc.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Slash
moves.text: Slashes with claws, etc. Has a high critical-hit ratio.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User’s critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

moves.name: Sleep Powder
moves.text: Scatters a powder that may cause the foe to sleep.
moves.desc: Puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.text: Uses an available move randomly while asleep.
moves.desc:
Only usable if the user is sleeping. Randomly selects and uses one of the user’s other three moves. Use of the selected move requires and costs 0 PP.

This move will not select Assist, Bide, Bounce, Chatter, Copycat, Dig, Dive, Fly, Focus Punch, Me First, Metronome, Mirror Move, Shadow Force, Skull Bash, Sky Attack, Sky Drop, Sleep Talk, Solar Beam, Razor Wind, or Uproar.

If the selected move requires a recharge turn—i.e., one of Blast Burn, Frenzy Plant, Giga Impact, Hydro Cannon, Hyper Beam, Roar of Time, or Rock Wrecker—and the user is still sleeping next turn, then it’s forced to use this move again and pay another PP for the recharge turn.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist, Metronome, or Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Sludge
moves.text: Sludge is hurled to inflict damage. May also poison.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.text: Sludge is hurled to inflict damage. May also poison.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Smelling Salts
moves.text: Powerful against paralyzed foes, but also heals them.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If the target is paralyzed, this move has double power, and the target is cured of its paralysis.

moves.name: Smog
moves.text: An exhaust-gas attack that may also poison.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Smokescreen
moves.text: Lowers the foe’s accuracy using smoke, ink, etc.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

moves.name: Snatch
moves.text: Steals the effects of the move the target uses next.
moves.desc:
The next time a Pokémon uses a beneficial move on itself or itself and its ally this turn, the user of this move will steal the move and use it itself. Moves which may be stolen by this move are identified by the "snatchable" flag.

If two Pokémon use this move on the same turn, the faster Pokémon will steal the first beneficial move, and the slower Pokémon will then steal it again—thus, only the slowest Pokémon using this move ultimately gains a stolen move’s effect.

If the user steals Psych Up, it will target the Pokémon that used Psych Up. If the user was the original target of Psych Up, and the Pokémon that originally used it’s affected by Pressure, it will only lose 1 PP.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Snore
moves.text: A loud attack that can be used only while asleep.
moves.desc: Only usable if the user is sleeping. Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Soft-Boiled
moves.text: Recovers up to half the user’s maximum HP.
moves.desc: Heals the user for half its max HP.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.text: Absorbs light in one turn, then attacks next turn.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User charges for one turn before attacking.

During Sunny Day, the charge turn is skipped.

During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, power is halved.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Sonic Boom
moves.text: Launches shock waves that always inflict 20 HP damage.
moves.desc: Inflicts exactly 20 damage.

moves.name: Spark
moves.text: An electrified tackle that may paralyze the foe.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Spider Web
moves.text: Ensnares the foe to stop it from fleeing or switching.
moves.desc:
The target cannot switch out normally. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. This effect ends when the user leaves the field.

The target may still escape by using Baton Pass, U-turn, or a Shed Shell.

Both the user and the target pass on this effect with Baton Pass.

moves.name: Spike Cannon
moves.text: Launches sharp spikes that strike 2 to 5 times.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits 2–5 times in one turn.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

moves.name: Spikes
moves.text: Sets spikes that hurt a foe switching in.
moves.desc:
Scatters spikes around the opposing field, which damage opposing Pokémon that enter the field for 1/8 of their max HP. Pokémon immune to Ground moves are immune to this damage, except during Gravity. Up to three layers of spikes may be laid down, adding 1/16 to the damage done: two layers of spikes damage for 3/16 max HP, and three layers damage for 1/4 max HP.

Wonder Guard does not block damage from this effect.

Rapid Spin removes this effect from its user’s side of the field. Defog removes this effect from its target’s side of the field.

moves.name: Spit Up
moves.text: Releases stockpiled power (the more the better).
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Power is equal to 100 times the amount of energy stored by Stockpile. Ignores the random factor in the damage formula. Stored energy is consumed, and the user’s Defense and Special Defense are reset to what they would be if Stockpile had not been used. If the user has no energy stored, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move.

moves.name: Spite
moves.text: Spitefully cuts the PP of the foe’s last move.
moves.desc: Lowers the PP of the target’s last used move by 4. If the target hasn’t used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, or if its last used move has 0 PP remaining, this move will fail.

moves.name: Splash
moves.text: It’s just a splash... Has no effect whatsoever.
moves.desc:
Does nothing.

This move cannot be used while Gravity is in effect.

moves.name: Spore
moves.text: Scatters a cloud of spores that always induce sleep.
moves.desc: Puts the target to sleep.

moves.name: Steel Wing
moves.text: Strikes the foe with hard wings spread wide.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Defense one stage.

moves.name: Stockpile
moves.text: Charges up power for up to 3 turns.
moves.desc:
In Emerald:
• Does not raise Defense or Special Defense.

Raises the user’s Defense and Special Defense by one stage each. Stores energy for use with Spit Up and Swallow. Up to three levels of energy can be stored, and all are lost if the user leaves the field. Energy is still stored even if the stat boosts cannot be applied.

If the user uses Baton Pass, the stat boosts are passed as normal, but the stored energy is not.

moves.name: Stomp
moves.text: Stomps the enemy with a big foot. May cause flinching.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

Power is doubled against Pokémon that have used Minimize since entering the field.

moves.name: Strength
moves.text: Builds enormous power, then slams the foe.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: String Shot
moves.text: Binds the foe with string to reduce its SPEED.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Speed by one stage.

moves.name: Struggle
moves.text: Used only if all PP are gone. Also hurts the user a little.
moves.desc:
In Emerald:
• The user receieves 1/2 of the damage dealt in recoil.

Inflicts typeless regular damage. User takes 1/4 its max HP in recoil. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

This move is used automatically when a Pokémon cannot use any other move legally, e.g., due to having no PP remaining or being under the effect of both Encore and Torment at the same time.

This move’s recoil is not treated as recoil for the purposes of anything that affects recoil, such as the ability Rock Head. It also is not prevented by Magic Guard.

This move cannot be copied by Mimic, Mirror Move, or Sketch, nor selected by Assist or Metronome, nor forced by Encore.

moves.name: Stun Spore
moves.text: Scatters a powder that may paralyze the foe.
moves.desc: Paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Submission
moves.text: A reckless body slam that also hurts the user.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.text: Creates a decoy using 1/4 of the user’s maximum HP.
moves.desc:
Transfers 1/4 the user’s max HP into a doll that absorbs damage and causes most negative move effects to fail. If the user leaves the field, the doll will vanish. If the user cannot pay the HP cost, this move will fail.

The doll takes damage as normal, using the user’s stats and types, and will break when its HP reaches zero. Self-inflicted damage from confusion or recoil is not absorbed. Healing effects from opponents ignore the doll and heal the user as normal. Moves that work based on the user’s HP still do so; the doll’s HP does not influence any move.

The doll will block major status effects, confusion, and flinching. The effects of Smelling Salts and Wake-Up Slap do not trigger against a doll, even if the Pokémon behind the doll has the appropriate major status effect. Multi-turn trapping moves like Wrap will hit the doll for their regular damage, but the multi-turn trapping and damage effects will not activate.

Moves blocked or damage absorbed by the doll do not count as hitting the user or inflicting damage for any effects that respond to such, e.g., Avalanche, Counter, or a Rowap Berry. Magic Coat still works as normal, even against moves the doll would block. Opposing Pokémon that damage the doll with a leech move like Absorb are healed as normal.

It will also block Acupressure, Block, the curse effect of Curse, Dream Eater, Embargo, Flatter, Gastro Acid, Grudge, Heal Block, Leech Seed, Lock-On, Mean Look, Mimic, Mind Reader, Nightmare, Pain Split, Psycho Shift, Spider Web, Sketch, Swagger, Switcheroo, Trick, Worry Seed, and Yawn. A Pokémon affected by Yawn before summoning the doll will still fall to sleep.

The doll blocks Intimidate, but all other abilities act as though the doll did not exist. If the user has an ability that absorbs moves of a certain type for HP (such as Volt Absorb absorbing Thunder Wave), such moves will not be blocked.

Life Orb and berries that cause confusion still work as normal, but their respective HP loss and confusion are absorbed/blocked by the doll.

The user is still vulnerable to damage inflicted when entering or leaving the field, such as by Pursuit or Spikes; however, the doll will block the poison effect of Toxic Spikes.

The doll is passed on by Baton Pass. It keeps its existing HP, but uses the replacement Pokémon’s stats and types for damage calculation.

All other effects work as normal.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.text: Boosts the power of FIRE- type moves for 5 turns.
moves.desc:
Changes the weather to sunshine for five turns, during which Fire moves inflict 50% extra damage, and Water moves inflict half damage.

If the user is holding Heat Rock, this effect lasts for eight turns.

Pokémon cannot become frozen.

Thunder has 50% accuracy.

Solar Beam skips its charge turn.

Moonlight, Morning Sun, and Synthesis heal 2/3 of the user’s max HP.

Pokémon with Chlorophyll have doubled original Speed.

Pokémon with Forecast become Fire.

Pokémon with Leaf Guard are not affected by major status effects.

Pokémon with Flower Gift change form; every Pokémon on their side of the field have their original Attack and Special Attack increased by 50%.

Pokémon with Dry Skin lose 1/8 max HP at the end of each turn.

Pokémon with Solar Power have their original Special Attack raised by 50% but lose 1/8 their max HP at the end of each turn.

moves.name: Super Fang
moves.text: Attacks with sharp fangs and cuts half the foe’s HP.
moves.desc: Inflicts typeless damage equal to half the target’s remaining HP.

moves.name: Superpower
moves.text: Boosts strength sharply, but lowers abilities.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage each.

moves.name: Supersonic
moves.text: Emits bizarre sound waves that may confuse the foe.
moves.desc: Confuses the target.

moves.name: Surf
moves.text: Creates a huge wave, then crashes it down on the foe.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage.

If the target is in the first turn of Dive, this move will hit with double power.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.text: Confuses the foe, but also sharply raises ATTACK.
moves.desc: Raises the target’s Attack by two stages, then confuses it. If the target’s Attack cannot be raised by two stages, the confusion is not applied.

moves.name: Swallow
moves.text: Absorbs stockpiled power and restores HP.
moves.desc: Heals the user depending on the amount of energy stored by Stockpile: 1/4 its max HP after one use, 1/2 its max HP after two uses, or fully after three uses. Stored energy is consumed, and the user’s Defense and Special Defense are reset to what they would be if Stockpile had not been used. If the user has no energy stored, this move will fail.

moves.name: Sweet Kiss
moves.text: Demands a kiss with a cute look. May cause confusion.
moves.desc: Confuses the target.

moves.name: Sweet Scent
moves.text: Allures the foe to reduce evasiveness.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s evasion by one stage.

moves.name: Swift
moves.text: Sprays star-shaped rays that never miss.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.text: A fighting dance that sharply raises ATTACK.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.text: Restores HP. The amount varies with the weather.
moves.desc:
Heals the user for half its max HP.

During Sunny Day, the healing is increased to 2/3 max HP.

During Hail, Rain Dance, or Sandstorm, the healing is decreased to 1/4 max HP.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.text: Charges the foe with a full- body tackle.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Tail Glow
moves.text: Flashes a light that sharply raises SP. ATK.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Special Attack by two stages.

moves.name: Tail Whip
moves.text: Wags the tail to lower the foe’s DEFENSE.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.text: A reckless charge attack that also hurts the user.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/4 the damage it inflicts in recoil.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.text: Taunts the foe into only using attack moves.
moves.desc:
Target is forced to only use damaging moves for the next 3–5 turns, selected at random. Moves that select other moves not known in advance do not count as damaging.

Assist, Copycat, Me First, Metronome, Mirror Move, and Sleep Talk do not directly inflict damage and thus may not be used.

Bide, Counter, Endeavor, Metal Burst, and Mirror Coat are allowed.

moves.name: Teeter Dance
moves.text: Confuses all POKéMON on the scene.
moves.desc: Confuses all targets.

moves.name: Teleport
moves.text: A psychic move for fleeing from battle instantly.
moves.desc: Does nothing. Wild battles end immediately.

moves.name: Thief
moves.text: While attacking, it may steal the foe’s held item.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. If the target is holding an item and the user is not, the user will permanently take the item. Damage is still inflicted if an item cannot be taken.

Pokémon with Sticky Hold or Multitype are immune to the item theft effect.

The target cannot recover its item with Recycle.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Thrash
moves.text: A rampage of 2 to 3 turns that confuses the user.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to attack with this move for 2–3 turns,selected at random. After the last hit, the user becomes confused.

Safeguard does not protect against the confusion from this move.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.text: A lightning attack that may cause paralysis.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

During Rain Dance, this move has 100% accuracy. It also has a (100 - accuracy)% chance to break through the protection of Protect and Detect.

During Sunny Day, this move has 50% accuracy.

moves.name: Thunder Punch
moves.text: An electrified punch that may paralyze the foe.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Thunder Shock
moves.text: An electrical attack that may paralyze the foe.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.text: A weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the foe.
moves.desc: Paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.text: A strong electrical attack that may paralyze the foe.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Tickle
moves.text: Makes the foe laugh to lower ATTACK and DEFENSE.
moves.desc: Lowers the target’s Attack and Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Torment
moves.text: Torments the foe and stops successive use of a move.
moves.desc:
Prevents the target from attempting to use the same move twice in a row. When the target leaves the field, this effect ends.

If the target is forced to attempt a repeated move due to Choice Band, Choice Scarf, Choice Specs, Disable, Encore, Taunt, only having PP remaining for one move, or any other effect, the target will use Struggle instead. The target is then free to use the forced move next turn, as it didn’t use that move this turn.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.text: Poisons the foe with an intensifying toxin.
moves.desc: Badly poisons the target. Never misses when used by a Poison-type Pokémon.

moves.name: Transform
moves.text: Alters the user’s cells to become a copy of the foe.
moves.desc:
User copies the target’s species, weight, type, ability, calculated stats (except HP), and moves. Copied moves will all have 5 PP remaining. IVs are copied for the purposes of Hidden Power, but stats are not recalculated.

Choice Band, Choice Scarf, and Choice Specs stay in effect, and the user must select a new move.

This move cannot be copied by Mirror Move, nor forced by Encore.

moves.name: Tri Attack
moves.text: Fires three types of beams at the same time.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to burn, freeze, or paralyze the target. One of these effects is selected at random; they do not each have independent chances to occur.

moves.name: Trick
moves.text: Tricks the foe into trading held items.
moves.desc:
User and target permanently swap held items. Works even if one of the Pokémon isn’t holding anything. If either Pokémon is holding mail, this move will fail.

If either Pokémon has Multitype or Sticky Hold, this move will fail.

If this move results in a Pokémon obtaining Choice Band, Choice Scarf, or Choice Specs, and that Pokémon was the latter of the pair to move this turn, then the move it used this turn becomes its chosen forced move. This applies even if both Pokémon had a choice item before this move was used. If the first of the two Pokémon gains a choice item, it may select whatever choice move it wishes next turn.

Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle.

This move cannot be selected by Assist or Metronome.

moves.name: Triple Kick
moves.text: Kicks the foe 3 times in a row with rising intensity.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Hits three times in the same turn. The second hit has double power, and the third hit has triple power. Each hit has a separate accuracy check, and this move stops if a hit misses.

Skill Link does not apply.

moves.name: Twineedle
moves.text: Stingers on the forelegs jab the foe twice.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Hits twice in the same turn. Has a chance to poison the target.

moves.name: Twister
moves.text: Whips up a vicious twister to tear at the foe.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make each target flinch.

If the target is under the effect of Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, this move will hit with double power.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.text: Causes an uproar for 2 to 5 turns and prevents sleep.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. User is forced to use this move for 2–5 turns, selected at random. All Pokémon on the field wake up, and none can fall to sleep until the lock-in ends.

Pokémon cannot use Rest during this effect.

This move cannot be selected by Sleep Talk.

moves.name: Vine Whip
moves.text: Strikes the foe with slender, whiplike vines.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Vise Grip
moves.text: Grips the foe with large and powerful pincers.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Vital Throw
moves.text: Makes the user’s move last, but it never misses.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

moves.name: Volt Tackle
moves.text: A life-risking tackle that slightly hurts the user.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. User takes 1/3 the damage it inflicts in recoil. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

moves.name: Water Gun
moves.text: Squirts water to attack the foe.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Water Pulse
moves.text: Attacks with ultrasonic waves. May confuse the foe.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to confuse the target.

moves.name: Water Sport
moves.text: The user becomes soaked to raise resistance to fire.
moves.desc: Fire moves inflict half damage, regardless of target. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

moves.name: Water Spout
moves.text: Inflicts more damage if the user’s HP is high.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Power increases with the user’s remaining HP and is given by `150 * HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 150 when the user has full HP.

moves.name: Waterfall
moves.text: Charges the foe with speed to climb waterfalls.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Weather Ball
moves.text: The move’s type and power change with the weather.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. If a weather move is active, this move has double power, and its type becomes the type of the weather move. Shadow Sky is typeless for the purposes of this move.

moves.name: Whirlpool
moves.text: Traps and hurts the foe in a whirlpool for 2 to 5 turns.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

If the target is in the first turn of Dive, this move will hit with double power.

moves.name: Whirlwind
moves.text: Blows away the foe with wind and ends the battle.
moves.desc:
Switches the target out for another of its trainer’s Pokémon selected at random. Wild battles end immediately.

Doesn’t affect Pokémon with Suction Cups or under the effect of Ingrain.

moves.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.text: Inflicts a burn on the foe with intense fire.
moves.desc: Burns the target.

moves.name: Wing Attack
moves.text: Strikes the foe with wings spread wide.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage.

moves.name: Wish
moves.text: A wish that restores HP. It takes time to work.
moves.desc:
In Emerald:
• Heals replacement Pokémon by half of their max HP.

At the end of the next turn, user will be healed for half its max HP. If the user is switched out, its replacement will be healed instead for half of the user’s max HP. If the user faints or is forcefully switched by Roar or Whirlwind, this effect will not activate.

moves.name: Withdraw
moves.text: Withdraws the body into its hard shell to raise DEFENSE.
moves.desc: Raises the user’s Defense by one stage.

moves.name: Wrap
moves.text: Wraps and squeezes the foe 2 to 5 times with vines, etc.
moves.desc:
Inflicts regular damage. For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn. The user continues to use other moves during this time. If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times. Averages to 3 hits per use.

Rapid Spin cancels this effect.

moves.name: Yawn
moves.text: Lulls the foe into yawning, then sleeping next turn.
moves.desc:
Puts the target to sleep at the end of the next turn. Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers. If the target leaves the field, this effect is canceled. If the target has a status effect when this move is used, this move will fail.

If the target is protected by Safeguard when this move is used, this move will fail.

Insomnia and Vital Spirit prevent the sleep if the target has either at the end of the next turn, but will not cause this move to fail on use.

moves.name: Zap Cannon
moves.text: Powerful and sure to cause paralysis, but inaccurate.
moves.desc: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.
